description: This Java class 'Survey' models a survey entity within the Fineract system's Spring Application Management (SPM) domain. It represents survey metadata and relationships with components and questions, and is mapped to the 'm_surveys' database table. It contains properties like key, name, description, country code, and validity dates, along with getter and setter methods. It extends an abstract persistable class for ID management.

classes.name: Survey
classes.description: Entity class representing a survey with related components and questions, mapped to the database table 'm_surveys', including attributes for metadata and validity period.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Returns the list of components associated with the survey.

methods.name: setComponents
methods.description: Sets the list of components associated with the survey.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Returns the list of questions in the survey.

methods.name: setQuestions
methods.description: Sets the list of questions for the survey, replacing existing questions.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the unique key identifier for the survey.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the key identifier for the survey.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the survey.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the survey.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the survey.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the survey.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Retrieves the country code associated with the survey.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code for the survey.

methods.name: getValidFrom
methods.description: Retrieves the start date from which the survey is valid.

methods.name: setValidFrom
methods.description: Sets the start date for survey validity.

methods.name: getValidTo
methods.description: Retrieves the end date until which the survey is valid.

methods.name: setValidTo
methods.description: Sets the end date for survey validity.
